## Definitions

- [statement] $vectorSearch is a middle stage: it queries per input document and attaches an array under as; no matches produce an empty array. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-vectorsearch/ · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing per-event vector search enrichment · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/closing-gap-between-agentic-promise-impact-industry-leading-retrieval

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] A missing target index causes MongoServerError when search first executes; the processor enters an error state and stops. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-vectorsearch/ · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing per-event vector search enrichment
- [statement] limit exceeding numCandidates, or unsupported filter operators, produces PlanExecutor errors for every document at runtime. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-vectorsearch/ · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing per-event vector search enrichment
- [statement] Non-Atlas from.connectionName connections fail parsing. Empty as or metadata-name collisions cause StreamProcessorInvalidOptions at startup. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/sp-agg-vectorsearch/ · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing per-event vector search enrichment
- [statement] QuerySentinel documents ASP write-rate aggregation separately from SimilarIncidentAgent vector retrieval. Its reported vector-dimension mismatch is an application report, not evidence of native ASP-stage failure semantics. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/pulkit6732/QuerySentinel · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing per-event vector search enrichment

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The media architecture enriches clicks with article metadata, summarizes sessions, and serves semantic recommendations afterward; this differs from querying an index for each incoming event. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/solutions-library/stream-media-personalization.md · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing per-event vector search enrichment
- [statement] Gorman's March 28, 2025 example calls an LLM through $https; its vector-memory discussion proposes an extension rather than demonstrating the native $vectorSearch stage. (low confidence) — https://kennygorman.dev/2025/03/28/adding-probabilistic-reasoning-to-mongodb-atlas-stream-proce/ · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing per-event vector search enrichment
- [statement] Confluent warns that external stream enrichment can overload dependencies during replay, propagate latency/failures, and retrieve current rather than historical state. These are useful ASP validation questions, not established native-stage guarantees. (low confidence) — https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/ai/external-tables/overview.html · keywords: Atlas Stream Processing per-event vector search enrichment
